title: Reading an input bit
statement: Let $y$ be a Boolean word, let $l$ be an access label, and let $i,k,p$ be natural numbers. If the work-tape head position $q$ satisfies $-1\le q\le |\mathrm{bits}(|y|+1)|$, then there is a finite safe computation path from the configuration in read phase $eC$ with label $l$, parameters $i,k,p$, and head position $q$ to the configuration in which the read result is the optional bit of $y$ at index $i$ for ordinary labels or index $p$ for data labels, with the same other parameters and head position.
